prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED MINT / COOL SAGE-GREEN flat color field — think
#A8D5BA, a soft-but-clearly-green cool mint color, the kind of pale
green a board-game uses for "tundra/taiga/grassland" regions. The
green hue must be UNMISTAKABLE — a viewer should read this as
GREEN, not grey, not white, not beige. Saturated enough to be a
confident hue, clearly distinct from any other tile color. Fill the
ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this one mint-green color
corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border, NO vignette, NO
centered composition, NO visible foliage or terrain. Only the
faintest paint-texture variation within the same mint hue. A region-
fill swatch, not a tile with a shape drawn on it.
formatted_prompt: Flat saturated mint-green comic-map terrain tile, bold game-board region fill edge-to-edge in a 1024x1024 square. The entire image is one confident cool sage-green wash — unmistakably green, the clear board-game tundra hue near #A8D5BA — filling every corner with no horizon, no vignette, no border, no centered focal element, no drawn hex outline. Faint brushstroke texture variation ripples within the same mint register, suggesting paint tooth without breaking the flat read. Vivid, punchy, fresh color — not muted, not grey, not beige. A single saturated region-fill swatch in the manner of a Settlers of Catan grassland tile, bold ink confidence, zero aging or weathering.
